subject: maths
question:
The mean and the mode of a set of data are 47.4 and 61.6, respectively. Find the median of the data set, using the empirical formula.

(Round off your answer to one decimal place.)
solution:
**Given:**

Mean of the data set = 47.4

Mode of the data set = 61.6

**Formula Used:**

Empirical formula: Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

**Calculation:**

Using the formula:

Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

⇒ 61.6 = 3(Median) - 2(47.4)

⇒ 61.6 = 3(Median) - 94.8

⇒ 3(Median) = 61.6 + 94.8

⇒ 3(Median) = 156.4

⇒ Median = 156.4 / 3

⇒ Median = 52.1

**The median of the data set is 52.1 (correct option: 1).**
